name: 33565 · Plant City, FL
findings: ZIP 33565 (Plant City) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33565 (Plant City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33565 (Plant City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
